title: Eldritch Patron & Outer Entity
body: Archetype for cosmic horrors, forgotten sleeping gods, abyssal leviathans, and warlock patrons bound by perilous pacts.

sampleValues.Realm or Slumbering Prison: Suspended inside a mirror-sea three miles beneath the Salt Wastes
sampleValues.Sensory Distortion & Omens: Reflections lag half a heartbeat behind; bells ring underwater when no bells exist.
sampleValues.Boons Granted to Servants: Speak all dead tongues and step between still reflections at midnight.
sampleValues.Pact Cost & Corruption: Warlocks slowly lose the ability to recognize their own faces in mirrors.
sampleValues.Hidden Cults & Binding Seals: The Order of Silvered Eyes maintains mercury seals that must be polished every eclipse.
